class.name: SimTelemetryManager
class.brief_description: Core manager for simulator connections, telemetry data acquisition, and session handling.
class.description: [SimTelemetryManager] handles real-time telemetry data across multiple simulators via the modular ISimProvider architecture. It provides thread-safe background logging functionality to connect to supported simulators, log telemetry channels based on time or distance, and load/analyze previously recorded sessions.

method.name: connect_to_sim
method.description: Establishes a connection to the specified simulator (e.g., "AC", "ACC"). Use [method detect_active_sim] to discover the active simulator first. Returns an empty string on success, or an error message on failure.

method.name: detect_active_sim
method.description: Scans shared memory signatures to detect which simulator is currently running and returns its ID.

method.name: disconnect_from_sim
method.description: Closes all shared memory connections to the current simulator. Safe to call even if not connected.

method.name: start_logging
method.description: Starts thread-safe background logging of telemetry data. Requires an [param output_file_path] as a fallback in case of unexpected disconnection. Returns an error string if it fails.

method.name: finish_logging
method.description: Stops logging and saves the telemetry session to the specified file. If [param output_file_path] is empty, the path provided in [method start_logging] is used. Returns the output path on success, or an error string.

method.name: get_live_static_data
method.description: Returns a dictionary with static information (track, car model, player name) for the live session.

method.name: get_live_snapshot
method.description: Retrieves the most recent telemetry snapshot as a single-point [GDLapTelemetry] object. Useful for live dashboards.

method.name: load_session_data
method.description: Loads a previously saved telemetry session from [param file_path]. Returns an empty string on success, or an error message.

method.name: get_session_metadata
method.description: Parses the metadata (lap counts, intervals, track info) of a session file without loading the entire telemetry data into memory.

method.name: get_loaded_session_metadata
method.description: Returns the metadata of the currently loaded session.

method.name: get_loaded_session_lap_data
method.description: Returns a [GDLapTelemetry] object containing all channel data for the specified [param lap_index] (zero-indexed).

method.name: get_loaded_session_lap_stats
method.description: Returns key statistics for a given lap, such as top speed, minimum speed, and sector times.

method.name: get_loaded_session_static_data
method.description: Returns the static data dictionary of the currently loaded session.

method.name: get_loaded_session_lap_count
method.description: Returns the total number of laps recorded in the loaded session.

method.name: get_loaded_session_samples_per_meter
method.description: Returns the distance-based sampling rate used for the loaded session.

method.name: get_loaded_session_lap_fuel_consumption
method.description: Calculates the total fuel consumed (in liters) during the specified lap.

method.name: get_loaded_session_total_fuel_consumption
method.description: Calculates the total fuel consumed (in liters) across the entire loaded session.

method.name: get_loaded_session_total_laps
method.description: Returns the exact float value of total laps completed (including fractional completion of the final lap).

method.name: close_loaded_session
method.description: Closes the loaded session and frees its memory.

method.name: calculate_lap_time_delta
method.description: Calculates the time delta between a current lap and a target (reference) lap across distance. Returns an array of time differences.

method.name: get_array_min_max
method.description: Calculates and returns the minimum (x) and maximum (y) values of a numeric array. Useful for auto-scaling graphs.

method.name: get_channel_name
method.description: Converts a standard telemetry channel name into the internal format used by the currently active simulator provider.

method.name: is_connected_to_sim
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if actively connected to a simulator's shared memory.

method.name: get_current_sim_id
method.description: Returns the ID of the currently connected simulator.

method.name: get_sim_status
method.description: Returns the current simulation state from the active provider.

method.name: is_currently_logging
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the background logging thread is currently running.

members.member: The distance interval in meters between telemetry samples.
A 4-character signature added to the beginning of the saved binary session file.

signal.name: connection_lost
signal.description: Emitted when the shared memory connection to the simulator is unexpectedly lost (e.g., game closed).
